topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: Lord have mercy, there be stranger troubles afoot than a wayfarer lost to the skies. I've heard tell of these iron birds, but here in the valley, we're bound closer to the earth. When the clouds hang low and the winds whisper, we have little choice but to wait them out, much like your traveler. An important gathering, you say? T'would be like missing the first planting or the harvest moon. All the more reason to keep a steady heart and hope the saints smooth the path. Mayhaps a delay is no more than a reminder to cherish what's within reach. I reckon there's comfort and wisdom in the simple things, like a full barn and a favored meal once you're home.
